dashboard.welcome: The application foundation is running. Business modules are added phase by phase.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your work account.
login.useRecovery: Lost your phone? Use a recovery code
login.recoveryHint: Format XXXX-XXXX. After signing in you must enable 2FA again.

password.title: Change password
password.subtitle: Use a password only you know.
password.forcedSubtitle: You signed in with a temporary password. Create a new password to continue.
password.policy: At least 10 characters, with letters and digits.
password.tooShort: Password must be at least 10 characters.
password.needsLetterDigit: Password must contain letters and digits.
password.mismatch: New password and repeat do not match.

totp.title: Enable 2FA
totp.subtitle: Your role requires two-step verification.
totp.step1: Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar).
totp.step2: Scan the QR code below, or enter the key manually.
totp.step3: Enter the 6 digits shown in the app.
totp.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app

roles.intro: System roles can have their permissions edited but cannot be deleted. Custom roles can be created, cloned and deactivated. Changes apply immediately.
roles.caption: Roles
roles.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits, underscore. Cannot be changed.
roles.name: Role name
roles.viewAsHelp: Read-only preview: visible menus and sensitive data access. No session is created; recorded in the audit trail.
roles.matrixHelp: Each cell: data scope for that action (Own, Department, Project, All) or – for no permission.
roles.savedNow: Permissions saved; they apply to the next request.
roles.temporaryHelp: E.g. cover during leave. Revoked automatically after the end date.

workflow.bulkNeedsType: Pick one document type to approve in bulk.
workflow.empty: Nothing is waiting for your approval.
workflow.rejectedOne: {{number}} rejected and returned to the requester.
workflow.rejectHelp: The document returns to Draft. Say what the requester must fix.
workflow.withdrawHelp: The submission is cancelled and the document returns to Draft.

delegation.help: During the period the delegate may approve on your behalf. Every action is logged.
delegation.searchUser: Type a name or email (min. 2 letters)

doa.intro: Approval rules per document type. Rules are checked in order; the first match applies. Changes take effect after Director approval.
doa.editHelp: The change is sent to the Director and applies only after approval.
doa.name: Rule name
doa.nestedReadOnly: nested condition, change via system admin
doa.reasonHint: At least 5 characters; shown to the Director.
doa.submitted: Change submitted as {{number}}, awaiting Director approval.

master.empty: No data yet. Add rows one by one or import a CSV.
master.sensitiveHint: Personal data (PDP law); visible only with permission.
master.importHelp: Download the template, fill it in Excel, save as CSV. Rows with an existing code are updated. If any row is wrong, nothing is saved.
master.importFailed: {{count}} problems found. Nothing was saved; fix them and import again.

dms.rules: PDF, JPG or PNG, max. 20 MB

settings.more: Other settings (company profile, users, roles) arrive in phase 01a.
settings.demoHelp: Sample data to try the application. Every demo row is flagged and can be removed at once; configuration (COA, roles, DOA rules) stays.
settings.demoConfirmHelp: This cannot be undone and is recorded in the audit trail. Type {{word}} to continue.
settings.emailHelp: Send a test email to your address to check the configuration (EMAIL_PROVIDER, SMTP or Resend).

setup.subtitle: First-run setup of Nustrad ERP. Done only once.
setup.tokenMissing: SETUP_TOKEN is not set on the server. Ask IT to set it, then reload this page.
setup.strongPolicy: At least 12 characters with upper case, lower case, digit and symbol.
setup.resumeHelp: The Super Admin exists. Sign in to continue.
setup.totpHelp: 2FA is mandatory for the Super Admin. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6 digits.
setup.fixedHint: Currency IDR, time zone Asia/Jakarta, Indonesian language.
setup.logoLater: The GEK logo for documents can be uploaded later in Settings.
setup.deptHelp: The list is prefilled; edit, remove or add. Each department gets a cost center.
setup.demoHelp: Load demo data to try the application (can be removed at once later), or start empty.
setup.finishHelp: After finishing, the setup page closes for good and other users can be invited.
setup.doneHelp: The setup page is closed and cannot be opened again.

recovery.help: Store these 10 codes somewhere safe (e.g. a password vault). Each code signs you in once if your authenticator phone is lost. They will not be shown again.
recovery.confirm: I have saved my recovery codes
recovery.fileHeader: Nustrad ERP 2FA recovery codes — PT Global Energi KITA. Each code works once.

users.inviteSent: Invitation sent to {{email}}. The link is valid for 72 hours.

mode.invite: Email an invitation link (72 hours, single use)
mode.password: Temporary password (shown once, must be changed)

users.tempOnce: Temporary password, shown only once. Give it to the user directly; it must be changed at sign-in.
users.employeeHint: Link to the HR employee record.
users.caption: Users
users.oneSuperAdmin: There is only one active Super Admin. Add a second one so access is not lost if this account is locked.

done.invite: New invitation sent; the old link no longer works.
done.reset-2fa: 2FA reset; the user must enrol again.
done.force-logout: All sessions of the user ended.

users.importHelp: CSV or Excel with columns email, full_name, roles (codes separated by |), department_code, employee_code. Every new user gets an email invitation. If any row is wrong, nothing is saved.
users.acceptHelp: Create a password for your Nustrad ERP account.
users.linkNotEmailed: Email is not configured. Copy this activation link and give it to the user directly (valid 72 hours, single use).

onboarding.privacySubtitle: Under Law 27/2022 on Personal Data Protection.
onboarding.privacyRead: I have read the privacy notice
onboarding.profileSubtitle: Used in approvals and documents you sign.
onboarding.signatureHint: Optional now; needed for documents you sign. PNG on white.

tour.welcomeBody: You are signed in as {{roles}}. Menus and buttons follow your roles.
tour.menuBody: On the left: {{groups}}. Items marked "Soon" activate once their module is built.
tour.approvalsBody: Documents waiting for your decision are in My Approvals (count in the menu). The bell at the top right holds notifications, including certificates about to expire.
tour.helpBody: Switch active role, theme, language and password from your name menu at the top right. Access problems? Contact IT Admin.

sod.title: Segregation of duties
sod.intro: Role pairs that one person must not hold. A conflicting combination needs a reason and Director approval, is recorded in the register and reviewed monthly by the Lead Controller.
sod.conflictHelp: Give a reason to request an exception from the Director. The new roles apply after approval.

accessReview.intro: Quarterly review: every active user with roles, sensitive data access and last login. Users without a login for more than {{days}} days are flagged.
accessReview.caption: User access review

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your work email. We will send a link to create a new password.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.subtitle: Create a new password for your account.
reset.done: Password updated. All old sessions were ended; please sign in again.
reset.noToken: The link is incomplete. Open the link from the email or request a new one.

crm.clientHint: Leave empty for a new prospect.
crm.qualifyHint: Meet at least {{min}} criteria to qualify.
crm.fromLeadHint: Opportunities are created from qualified leads ("Turn into opportunity").
crm.bidPendingNote: The bid/no-bid decision is waiting for the Director; the stage cannot change until decided.
crm.qualifiedHint: Quotation is reached only through a bid decision approved by the Director.
crm.stageHint: Move the stage as the quotation progresses.
crm.bidHelp: Score six aspects 1–5. A score ≥ {{threshold}}% recommends bid; the Director decides.
crm.justifyHint: The proposal differs from the score recommendation: give a reason (min. 10 characters).
crm.wonHelp: Creates the contract (rate schedule from the quotation after discount) and a draft project (budget from quoted cost + contingency) in one step.
crm.paymentTermHint: Leave empty to use the client's term.
crm.submittedHint: The quotation was sent. Mark won or lost once the client decides.

next.draft: Complete the lines, save, then submit. Margin ≥ 25% goes to the Head of Sales, below that to the Director.
next.approved: Ready to send to the client with an official letter number.
next.rejected: Rejected. Create a revision to fix it.
next.sent: Sent to the client. Create a revision if the client asks for changes.

emailStatus.not_configured: Email is not configured; send the PDF manually.

quotation.title: Quotation
quotation.fromOppHint: Quotations are created from the opportunity page at the Quotation stage.
quotation.lowMarginBanner: Margin {{value}}% is below {{threshold}}%. Check prices and discount before submitting; Director approval is required.
quotation.linesHelp: Add lines from the price database; quantity, cost and price can be edited. Totals and margin are computed by the server on save.
quotation.readOnly: Read-only. Create a revision to change it.
quotation.unsaved: Unsaved changes; the totals above are not updated yet.
quotation.reviseHelp: The new revision copies the lines of this one. The old revision is kept as history.
quotation.sendHelp: Issues letter number 001/GEK-SLS/…, stores the PDF in documents and moves the opportunity to Submitted.
quotation.alsoEmail: Also email the client contact (PDF attached)
quotation.emailNotConfigured: Email is not configured: the letter is still issued, send the PDF manually.
quotation.startHelp: The opportunity is at the Quotation stage. Create a quotation from the price database.

contract.fromWonHint: Contracts are created automatically when an opportunity is marked won.
contract.ratesHelp: From the quotation after discount. Add manual rates: equipment standby/breakdown, personnel per day, consumables (cost + markup), mob/demob.

project.name: Project name
project.budgetHelp: Draft from the quoted cost + {{pct}}% contingency. Read-only; budget editing and locking come in phase 03.
project.editorHelp: Enter the budget per cost element and WBS (whole rupiah). Contingency is a locked reserve. Totals and margin are computed by the server on save.
project.readOnlyBudget: Read-only. After lock the budget changes through a BCR.
project.marginBelow: Planned margin {{value}}% is below {{min}}%: the Lead Controller cannot approve.
project.controlHelp: Available = budget − pre-commitment (PR) − commitment (PO) − actual. Warning at 80%, red when exhausted.
project.noVersions: No versions yet; baseline v0 is created when the budget is locked.
project.teamHelp: Team members (e.g. field engineers) work on this project with their project-scoped rights: material requests, DOR.

tender.title: Tender
tender.fromOppHint: Tender data is created from an opportunity marked as a tender.
tender.priceLocked: Locked while the package is processed
tender.checklistHelp: Status is computed: Present when a file is attached and still valid at closing; expired = missing. Mark N/A when not requested.
tender.filesHelp: Upload documents for this checklist item (PDF/JPG/PNG).
tender.question: Question
tender.packageHelp: Technical by the Head of Operation and commercial by the Director, in parallel. Enabled with 0 missing mandatory documents and a price.
tender.submissionHelp: Record time, channel and receipt after the package is approved; attach the proof.
tender.resultHelp: Lost, disqualified or cancelled closes the opportunity as Lost. Won: mark the opportunity won to create the contract and project.
tender.wonHint: Continue with "Mark won" on the opportunity:
tender.startHelp: This opportunity is a tender. Create the tender data for schedule, documents and package approval.

bcr.help: Contingency release up to the remaining contingency ({{contingency}}); transfer up to the source line's available. Increase ≤ 10% or contingency/transfer approved by the Head of Operation; increase > 10% or a revenue change by the Director.
bcr.revenueHint: Fill in when the client raises the contract value (to the Director).
bcr.attachmentsHelp: Attach the client VO, vendor quotes or other evidence for this BCR.
bcr.forDocument: BCR for {{number}} (amount = shortfall rounded up to Rp 1 M).

pr.askPlanner: Ask the project planner to request a BCR of {{amount}} referencing {{number}}.

rfq.createHelp: Pick the category and at least 3 qualified vendors. Vendors with pending CSMS or blacklisted cannot be selected.
rfq.title: Quotes for {{pr}}
rfq.quotesHelp: Score: price = lowest/price, delivery = fastest/days, rating = rating/5.
rfq.awardHelp: The best score is awarded directly. Another vendor needs a written reason and Head of Finance & Support approval.

po.issueHelp: Issuing releases the PR pre-commitment and commits the DPP; the PR remainder returns to available. The PDF is stored in documents.
po.reviseHelp: Same or lower value applies at once (the difference returns to budget). A higher value needs re-approval.

gr.howTo: Create a GR from an issued PO ("Receive goods/services" button).
gr.noPo: Pick a PO first from the PO page.
gr.goodsWho: Goods are received by the Warehouse Head.
gr.serviceWho: Services are received by the project owner (project manager).
gr.notAllowed: You may not receive this PO, or the PO is not issued.
gr.warehouseHint: Leave empty when the goods go straight to the project (charged to the project).
gr.tooMuch: Quantity exceeds what is still open.
gr.evidenceHint: After saving the draft, attach goods photos/delivery note or the BAST, then post.
gr.attachGoods: Attach goods photos or the delivery note before posting.
gr.attachService: Attach the signed BAST before posting.
gr.postHelp: Posting records actual cost (commitment → actual) and the GR/IR journal; stock items go to inventory (1310) at moving-average cost.
gr.noJournal: The journal is created when the GR is posted.

mr.howTo: Site stock is used first, then Base stock. Any shortfall automatically becomes a PR at the last price.
mr.noProjects: You are not on any project team yet. Ask the project manager to add you.
mr.noPrice: No last price yet; a shortfall cannot become a PR.

stock.title: Inventory
stock.transferHelp: Move stock between warehouses (e.g. Base Cilegon → project site) at the source warehouse's average cost.
stock.countHelp: Enter counted quantities. Variances need Lead Controller approval before stock and the ledger are adjusted.
stock.reorderHelp: Items whose stock across all warehouses is at or below the reorder point. Suggestion: refill to 2× the reorder point at the last price.
stock.noReorder: All items are above their reorder point.
stock.reconciled: Stock valuation equals the balance of account 1310 Inventory.
stock.notReconciled: Stock valuation differs by {{diff}} from account 1310. Check manual journals to the inventory account.
stock.submitHelp: No variance: closed at once. With variance: sent to the Lead Controller.

ledger.manualHelp: Approved by the Lead Controller (the creator cannot approve). Closed periods are refused.
ledger.openingHelp: Once, as of the go-live date. Workbook with sheets GL (account, debit, credit), AR (client, invoice no, date, due date, amount), AP (vendor, ...), Stock (warehouse, item, qty, value), Assets (asset, cost, accumulated depreciation). Must balance; if any row is wrong nothing is saved.
ledger.openingDone: Opening balance imported as of {{date}}. Correct with manual journals.
ledger.openingPosted: Journal {{journal}} posted: AR {{ar_items}}, AP {{ap_items}}, stock {{stock_rows}}, assets {{assets}}.
ledger.rulesHelp: Every financial event uses these posting rules (ACCOUNTING.md). The Lead Controller can change accounts; @expense = expense account of the cost element, @variance = inventory variance account.

vi.search: Search number, invoice no., tax invoice, PO, vendor
vi.agingAsOf: As of {{date}} (outstanding on approved invoices, by days past due).
vi.statementHelp: From the ledger, account 2110 Accounts payable: invoices increase (credit), payments and credit notes decrease (debit).
vi.dppHint: Leave empty to use the line total; enter the invoice's figure when it differs.
vi.ppnAsFaktur: VAT as on the tax invoice
vi.noNpwp: Vendor has no NPWP: PPh 23 rate doubles (4%).
vi.howTo: Pick a PO with posted receipts. Lines are filled with what was received but not yet billed, at the PO price; adjust to the vendor's invoice.
vi.noPo: No PO with posted receipts yet.
vi.approvedNote: Matches the PO and GR. Journal posted; the invoice can enter a payment run.
vi.noJournal: The journal is posted when the invoice matches (approved for payment).
vi.attachHint: Attach the invoice and tax invoice scans, then match against the PO and GR.
vi.matchHelp: Per line: billed quantity ≤ received not yet billed, price = PO price (tolerance per setting, default 0).
vi.correctHelp: For typing errors. After saving, the invoice returns to draft to be matched again.
vi.creditNoteHelp: A vendor credit note reduces the invoice DPP/VAT. Enter the corrected lines; the invoice returns to draft to be matched again.

dor.pending: {{count}} DOR on this device waiting to sync
dor.onDeviceHelp: Drafts saved on the device. They sync automatically when the connection is back.
dor.listOffline: The server list is not available offline. Drafts on the device can still be opened.
dor.noProject: Pick a project first from the DOR list.
dor.offlineNoCache: Offline and this project's form data is not on the device yet. Open it once while online.
dor.savedOffline: Saved on the device. It will be sent automatically when online.
dor.readOnly: The DOR has been submitted; it cannot be changed.
dor.equipmentHelp: Operating + standby + breakdown + rig-up/down must be 24 hours. Breakdown is not billed unless agreed.
dor.crewHelp: People with an expired mandatory certificate cannot be selected; warning when it ends within 60 days.
dor.consumablesHelp: From warehouse {{site}}; never more than in stock.
dor.operationsHelp: Decides who approves DORs (OFS/EPCOM Superintendent) and which technical data is captured.

mnt.importHelp: Sheet "Task Library" (task code, equipment type, task, frequency, form, checklist) and "Equipment Register" (asset code, name, type, criticality, certificate, valid until). If any row is wrong, nothing is saved.
mnt.imported: Tasks new {{tasks_created}}, updated {{tasks_updated}}; assets new {{assets_created}}, updated {{assets_updated}}.
mnt.noTasks: No PM tasks yet. Import the PM plan.
mnt.blockedAllocation: Cannot be allocated to a project: {{reason}}.
mnt.partsHelp: Issued from stock (average cost), journal 5200/1310. Total {{value}}.

qhse.riskHelp: A project needs a HIRADC or JSA approved by QHSE before its first DOR can be submitted. Risk = likelihood (L) × severity (S), 1–5.
qhse.title: Title
qhse.permitHelp: Valid for at most 24 hours; approved by QHSE other than the requester.

stats.formula: Man-hours from approved DORs. TRIR = recordable × 200,000 / man-hours; LTIFR = LTI × 1,000,000 / man-hours.

billing.title: Billing
billing.newTicketHelp: From approved, not yet billed DORs: one day or a period per project/contract.
billing.signHelp: The client can dispute lines with a reason; their value leaves the ticket and the revenue is reversed.
billing.typeSignature: Or type your name as the signature
billing.thanks: Thank you. The service ticket has been signed.
billing.newInvoiceHelp: Only from signed service tickets; one invoice per contract.

emailStatus.not_configured: E-mail not configured; the pack is saved in documents.
emailStatus.failed: E-mail failed; the pack is saved in documents.

billing.bpHelp: Upload the PPh 23 withholding slip in the Documents tab.
billing.receiptHelp: Journal: Dr 1110 (cash) + Dr 1410 (PPh 23 withheld by the client) / Cr 1210.
billing.bankImportHelp: CSV (date, description, amount, reference) or MT940. Credits only; duplicates skipped; auto-matched to invoices.
billing.disputeHelp: Lines disputed by the client; their revenue was reversed (4100/1220).

accounts.title: Bank accounts
accounts.hint: Balances come from the general ledger (the account's GL account). Pick an account to reconcile.

recon.title: Bank reconciliation
recon.hint: Import a statement (CSV or MT940). Lines are matched to the account's journal lines automatically (document number, or amount and date ±3 days). Match the rest by hand.

runs.title: Payment runs
runs.hint: The AP Accountant prepares, Head of Finance/Director approves (DOA), the Cashier releases. Three different people.
runs.newHint: Select approved vendor invoices and due liabilities (salaries, BPJS, PPh).
runs.sod: The preparer cannot approve; the approver and preparer cannot release. The account balance is checked on release.

advances.title: Cash advances
advances.hint: Requested by the employee, approved by the Head of Operation, paid by the Cashier, settled with receipts per cost element. Alert after 14 days.
advances.overdueHint: {{days}} days since disbursement. Please submit the settlement.
advances.refund: The requester returns {{amount}} to the bank.
advances.settlementHint: Upload receipt photos under Attachments, then pick the receipt for each line.

forecast.title: 13-week cash forecast
forecast.hint: Opening from the bank accounts. Monthly assumptions live in setting treasury.forecast.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.hint: Monthly period with a 25th cut-off. Site days and overtime from approved DORs; BPJS and PPh 21 TER from data tables. Calculated by HCBP → approved by Head of Finance → journal → paid through a payment run.
payroll.allocation: Field cost per project (by DOR days)
payroll.sod: The payroll calculator cannot approve it. Per-employee amounts are visible only with the salary permission.
payroll.annualHint: December: annual PPh 21 {{tax}} less {{withheld}} already withheld.
payroll.mineHint: Your approved payslips and the yearly 1721-A1 withholding slip.

tax.title: Monthly tax
tax.hint: Computed from the general ledger per period. Per type: billing code → payment (payment run or direct, NTPN) → SPT Masa filing (BPE). Reminder 3 days before each deadline.

lists.pph23_withheld: PPh 23 withheld by GEK (slips to vendors)

close.title: Period close
close.hint: Live checklist from the data. Red items block the close; amber items are allowed with a note. Closed by the Lead Controller; reopened only by the Head of Finance & Support with a reason.
close.note: Close note (required when there are warnings)

capex.title: CAPEX
capex.hint: Investment proposals with a business case (NPV, IRR, payback, buy vs rent vs lease) and a priority score. Approved by the Director; above Rp 5 bn also by the shareholders (RUPS). The locked plan uses budget control; costs go to AUC (1520) and are then capitalised.
capex.formHint: Actual rental spend in the last 12 months (account 5400): {{spend}} — used when the yearly rental cost is left empty.
capex.previewHint: Enter title, asset class and amount to see the business case.
capex.milestoneHint: Posted to the CAPEX project's AUC (1520) through budget control; above the budget needs a change request. Purchases through PR/PO/GR on the CAPEX project also land in AUC.
capex.changeHint: Extra budget is approved per the CAPEX DOA on the new total.
capex.commissioningHint: Upload the commissioning BAST, pick it and the asset code, then the Lead Controller capitalises (1510/1520).
capex.reviewHint: At 6 and 12 months after capitalisation: actual utilisation, revenue and payback against the case.

letters.title: Letters
letters.subject: Subject
letters.searchHint: Number, subject, sender or PDF text
letters.draftHint: Filled from a template; the number is assigned when the Director approves. On sending: letterhead PDF, electronic signature (PSrE) and e-Meterai when needed.

dmsdocs.title: Documents
dmsdocs.libraryHint: Legal documents, contracts, certificates, OEM manuals, MSDS, project folders, tender documents, restricted HR files. Retention and legal hold prevent archiving.
dmsdocs.controlledHint: SOPs, forms, manuals and policies; a revision release is approved by the Director and the old revision becomes Uncontrolled. Register import (Excel: code, title, kind, system, department, owner_email, review_months, affected_roles).
dmsdocs.searchHint: Searches titles, tags and file contents (PDF text layer) you may see.

lms.title: Training
lms.myHint: Training and SOPs you need to read. Assignments are created automatically: onboarding, expiring certificates and new SOP revisions.
lms.classroomHint: Completed by the training manager when class attendance / practical results are recorded.
lms.catalogueHint: Video, PDF, quiz, SCORM, classroom with attendance, supervised practical. Courses with a certificate name renew the employee certificate.
lms.sessionsHint: Attendance and results are recorded after the session; passing completes the assignment.
lms.matrixHint: Mandatory courses per position. Employees with a position code get assignments automatically.
lms.complianceHint: Mandatory courses and certificates per employee; expired certificates block DOR mobilisation.
lms.renewHint: Upload the new certificate scan; the employee record is updated and the DOR mobilisation block is lifted.
